mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_group (id, name, description, avatar, owner_user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{group.id}, #{group.name}, #{group.description}, #{group.avatar}, #{group.ownerUserId}, #{group.createdAt}, #{group.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_group WHERE id = #{groupId})

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.description, g.avatar, CASE WHEN g.owner_user_id = #{userId} THEN 'OWNER' ELSE 'MEMBER' END AS role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user) AS member_count, g.created_at, g.updated_at FROM chat_group g ORDER BY g.created_at, g.id

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.description, g.avatar, CASE WHEN g.owner_user_id = #{userId} THEN 'OWNER' ELSE 'MEMBER' END AS role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user) AS member_count, g.created_at, g.updated_at FROM chat_group g WHERE g.id = #{groupId}

SELECT users.id AS user_id, users.nickname, users.avatar, CASE WHEN users.id = g.owner_user_id THEN 'OWNER' ELSE 'MEMBER' END AS role, GREATEST(users.created_at, g.created_at) AS joined_at FROM chat_group g CROSS JOIN app_user users WHERE g.id = #{groupId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN users.id = g.owner_user_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, users.created_at, users.id
